title: record.v2
description: record.v1 plus the clinical fields asked for by the simulated clinical review of m3 (D-122): per medication route, strength (separate from the dose quantity), formulation, as_needed, food_timing, status, speaker and per-field evidence; per record patient_age_band and weight_kg. ADDITIVE: record.v1 is unchanged and stays the default for the bare name 'record'. Rules beyond JSON Schema (contracts/validate.py): every non-null new field has evidence in field_evidence (status 'unknown' needs none) and no evidence exists for a null field; strength_value and strength_unit are both set or both null; no Unicode bidi control characters (U+202A..U+202E, U+2066..U+2069) in any string; optional check that every span points into the transcript text. 'negated' keeps ONLY its sentence-level meaning (the spoken sentence about this drug is negated); the clinical meaning (prescribed, taken, advised against...) is in 'status'. A liquid formulation with a dose in ml and no strength is structurally VALID; the verifier (m4) must flag it (CR-LIQUID-STRENGTH). All records are synthetic. Like record.v1 there is no approver field: the save gate lives in m5_backend.

patient_ref.description: Synthetic patient reference (never a real identifier).

source_transcript_id.description: audio_id of the transcript.v1 this record was extracted from.

status.description: Workflow status of the whole RECORD (unchanged from v1). Not the same as medications[].status.

patient_age_band.description: null = no age was said. Bands (architect choice, UNVERIFIED, to be confirmed by a clinician): infant < 1 year; child 1-9 years; adolescent 10-17 years; adult 18-64 years; older_adult >= 65 years; unknown = something about age was said but it cannot be placed in a band. Convention: a word for child (e.g. 'ಮಗು') with no age is 'child' (it may really be an infant; the verifier must treat every non-adult band as not checkable against adult dose ranges).

weight_kg.description: null = no weight was said. value is in kilograms.

name.description: Canonical English symptom name, lower case (e.g. 'fever').

drug.description: Lexicon generic_en name (Latin script, lower case).

dose_value.description: Amount given PER ADMINISTRATION as spoken (5 ml, 1 tablet, 500 mg). Same meaning as v1.

negated.description: ONLY: the spoken sentence about this drug is grammatically negated (a negation cue applies to it). It no longer says what happened clinically; use status for that.

evidence.description: Main span: the drug mention and the v1 values (dose, frequency, duration), as in v1.

route.description: null = not said. injection_unspecified = 'injection' was said without IV/IM/SC.

strength_value.description: Strength of the PRODUCT (500 for a 500 mg tablet; 120 for 120 mg/5 ml syrup), separate from the dose quantity.

formulation.description: null = not said. Liquid formulations: syrup, suspension, drops.

as_needed.description: true = only when needed (e.g. 'only if fever'); false = explicitly regular; null = not said.

status.description: What the record claims about this drug: prescribed now; already taken before this encounter; not taken (a denied past exposure); advised against; stopped early (course not finished); continue an existing drug; unknown (cannot tell, or migrated from v1).

speaker.description: Role of the person who spoke the MAIN evidence span (gold speaker_role 'physician' maps to 'doctor'). transcript.v1 has no roles, so an extractor without turn roles writes 'unknown'.
Role of the person who spoke the evidence span: a request from a patient or caregiver is not clinical advice (D-122, finding M3-M2).

field_evidence.description: One evidence span per NEW field that is not null. Key 'strength' covers strength_value + strength_unit. A status of 'unknown' needs no evidence. The span may be in another turn than the main evidence (e.g. 'after food' said later, or a cross-turn 'no').
